title: Keep heavy frame-extraction binaries out of unrelated scheduled social-learning functions
root_cause: Netlify functions configuration globally included ffmpeg-static and its executable even in unrelated hourly social-learning and revenue-learning evaluators. The extra bundle size is a measured optimization target, but does not alone prove the root cause of 15-second 499 cancellations.
impact: In production both learning evaluation functions were about 32.5 MB, returned HTTP 499 near 15 seconds from Netlify Scheduler without a usable invocation, and social-learning_evaluations had zero new rows in 30 days.
fix: Move original ffmpeg-static external/include settings from [functions] to [functions."instagram-video-frames"] only, preserving the existing executable and identity verifier. Correct the canonical Netlify deploy applicability classifier so a netlify.toml-only change cannot be skipped by Netlify ignore-build.
prevention_rule: Large media tooling is isolated to functions that actually use it; ensure Netlify bundle parity and scheduled function real invocation before claiming completed source-qualified learning.
release_gates: Netlify config-only changes are deployment-required and cannot be skipped by ignore-build
Mira exact-video ffmpeg/frame extractor remains functional
Protected main merge and production deploy parity
Actual Netlify Scheduler 2xx response plus function invocation
New genuinely source-qualified social learning evaluation and subsequent action
outcome: CODE_CANDIDATE_ONLY: no production merge, video publication, learning row or revenue claim until independent provider readback.
